title: Sounds sure, might be wrong
label: AI CAN SOUND SURE AND BE WRONG

beats.say: An AI answer can sound completely sure and still be wrong.
These tools predict likely words, so they can make up a fact that sounds right.
For anything important, like health, money or law, check a trusted source.
Ask the tool for its sources, then open them yourself and see if they say that.
Use AI as a fast first draft, not as the final word.
Remember it, and send this to a friend who trusts every answer.
